gvim.workspace.report_named_changed: Extracted %{name} into workspace %{label}; the source tab changed and is still open
gvim.workspace.report_terminal_tab_chang: Extracted terminal tab %{name} into workspace %{label}; the source tab changed and is still open
gvim.workspace.report_terminal_tab_reviv: Extracted terminal tab %{name} into workspace %{label}; it revives on the first dive
gvim.workspace.report_evicted: Evicted workspace %{label} from memory (limit %{limit} materialized workspaces)
gvim.workspace.report_evicted_capture: %{message}; its capture write failed (%{error}) but the fallback save kept the session
gvim.notice.local_env_watch_unavailable: Local environment: file watching is unavailable (%{error}); changed detector markers are picked up on Env: Reload
gvim.notice.local_env_watch_ended: Local environment: the file watcher ended; changed detector markers are picked up on Env: Reload
gvim.notice.local_env_watch_root_failed: Local environment: cannot resolve the workspace root (%{error}); changed detector markers are picked up on Env: Reload
gvim.notice.local_env_watch_root_unwatch: Local environment: the workspace root cannot be watched; changed detector markers are picked up on Env: Reload
gvim.notice.local_env_watch_dirs: Local environment: %{count} detector marker director(ies) cannot be watched; changed markers there are picked up on Env: Reload
gvim.notice.local_env_watch_limit: Local environment: %{markers} detector marker path(s) in %{directories} director(ies) are not watched (watch bound reached); use Env: Reload after changing them
gvim.dock.tab_limit: Terminal: the tab limit is reached
gvim.dock.tab_limit_max: Terminal: the tab limit (%{max}) is reached
gvim.notice.local_env_watch_off: Local environment: file watching is off; changed detector markers are picked up on Env: Reload
gvim.notice.remote_search_nested_repos: remote search scanned the nested repositories/submodules in place because their candidate lists were unavailable; ignored entries may be scanned and results may be capped
gvim.notice.remote_search_ignored_candid: remote search scanned ignored entries because the candidate file list was too large to pass explicitly; results may be capped before every candidate file is searched
gvim.notice.remote_ignore_git_unavailabl: remote ignore scope unavailable: git could not run on the remote host; ignored files may be searched and tracked files that match .gitignore may be omitted
gvim.notice.remote_ignore_listing_failed: remote ignore scope unavailable: the remote git candidate listing failed or timed out; ignored files may be searched and tracked files that match .gitignore may be omitted
gvim.notice.remote_ignore_listing_trunca: remote ignore scope incomplete: the remote git candidate listing was truncated; ignored files may be searched and tracked files that match .gitignore may be omitted
gvim.notice.remote_search_cap_filtered: remote search result is incomplete: the bounded fallback scan hit the remote output cap before the file filter was applied, so matching files beyond the cap may be missing; narrow the scope or refine the query
gvim.notice.remote_search_index_closed: remote search fell back to a bounded fallback scan because the file index was closed; results may be incomplete
gvim.notice.remote_search_index_failed: remote search fell back to a bounded fallback scan because the file index failed (%{error}); results may be incomplete
gvim.notice.remote_search_index_idle: remote search fell back to a bounded fallback scan because the remote file index is not ready yet; results may be incomplete
gvim.notice.remote_search_index_truncate: remote search fell back to a bounded fallback scan because the file index is incomplete (truncated); results may be incomplete
gvim.notice.remote_search_index_unknown: remote search fell back to a bounded fallback scan because the file index cannot report whether it is complete; results may be incomplete
gvim.notice.remote_search_index_loading: remote search fell back to a bounded fallback scan while the file index is loading; results may be incomplete
gvim.notice.remote_live_grep_cap: remote Live Grep result is incomplete: the widened ignored-file scan hit the remote output cap; narrow the scope or refine the query
gvim.notice.remote_live_grep_stopped: remote Live Grep stopped early: the widened ignored-file scan failed on the remote host; the shown matches are incomplete
gvim.notice.remote_search_stale_snapshot: remote search was limited to the quick-open file-index snapshot; matching remote files outside it were not searched (they may be new since the index last refreshed, or excluded by the glob) — use File Explorer: Refresh to re-enumerate the index
gvim.command.resume_live_grep_desc: Reopen Live Grep with the prior query, match modes and scopes and search again; cached matches are never reused because file contents may have changed

gvim.notice.clipboard.busy: A clipboard write is still in progress; try again
gvim.notice.lsp.remote_root_timeout: Remote LSP root_markers scan timed out; using the workspace root
gvim.notice.lsp.remote_root_failed: Remote LSP root_markers scan failed: %{error}; using the workspace root
gvim.notice.lsp.remote_root_depth: Remote LSP root_markers scan stopped after %{depth} levels; using the workspace root
